rationale: The instrument is pinned — five consecutive one-minute candles all printed 30.79 on trivial volume, the entire daily range is two cents, and the 5-minute ATR (0.68 cents) is smaller than the one-cent bid-ask spread. Any entry pays a full spread round-trip (~3.2 bps) to capture movement smaller than that spread, with no news, no directional displacement, and no volatility to lean on; the expected edge is negative after costs regardless of direction.
